name: Jackie Waltman
office: City of Burbank, Member of the City Council

items.text: Jackie Waltman says she worked for more than 20 years in Child Protective Services and 30 years in law enforcement. She served as a Burbank Landlord-Tenant commissioner. She serves on the Civil Service Commission.

sentences.text: Jackie Waltman says she worked for more than 20 years in Child Protective Services and 30 years in law enforcement.
She served as a Burbank Landlord-Tenant commissioner.
She serves on the Civil Service Commission.

items.text: Her campaign says she would prioritize affordable housing and rent stabilization. Her candidate statement says she supports maintaining safe neighborhoods and funding for police, fire, and emergency services. At a candidate forum, she said Burbank's entertainment industry is in trouble and the city should seek to bring in other industries. She says Burbank's biggest need is to manage growth responsibly while protecting quality of life.
